hero.title: ERP Minero IA
hero.subtitle: Artificial intelligence for mining cost management
hero.description: A specialized analytics platform that transforms raw operational data from mining sites into actionable insights — using natural language queries, AI-powered explanations, and real-time cost breakdowns.

textQuery.title: Natural Language Queries
textQuery.description: Ask questions about costs, tonnage, or breakdowns in plain language. The AI interprets your intent, queries the database, and returns a table, chart, and AI-generated insight — all in one shot.

costVariance.title: Cost Variance Explainer
costVariance.description: Select any mine and month to see a deterministic decomposition of cost changes across 4 drivers: fuel, supplies, equipment, and labor — with a narrated AI explanation of what moved and why.

multiMine.title: Multi-mine Cross Analysis
multiMine.description: Compare costs, tonnage, and efficiency metrics across multiple mines simultaneously. Identify outliers, seasonal patterns, and performance gaps with a single query.

importance.title: Why AI for Mining Operations?
importance.body: Mining cost management generates thousands of data points monthly — fuel consumption, equipment wear, labor hours, and supplies across multiple sites. Traditional BI tools require SQL knowledge and pre-built dashboards. ERP Minero IA removes that barrier: any operator, manager, or analyst can ask a plain-language question and get an accurate, data-backed answer instantly. The AI layer doesn't replace domain expertise — it makes that expertise accessible to everyone in the organization.
